notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 clauses 9.5 through 9.9 object-attribute regional slice in Umbra's non-installable development profile. It uses only immutable candidate IDs exported by the Requirements Lab. Registration-established associations, additive/idempotent association, empty-region no-op behavior, overlap-filtered no-time updates, additive/idempotent regional subscriptions, and regional unsubscription are covered by a real Catch2 scenario. Default-region synthesis, advisory attributesInScope/attributesOutOfScope transitions, timestamped/retraction behavior, relaxed DDM, regional request forms, save/restore, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
